purpose: Large-deformation mechanical response matched to real Smooth-On silicones so the surface behaves correctly under load.

soft-clay-0030.use_case: true clay/flesh soft — fingertip-pressable, hero squishy surfaces
soft-clay-0030.datasheet_values_status: VERIFIED against Smooth-On Ecoflex 00-30 TDS 2026-07-31. NOTE: earlier nominal values were WRONG (elongation 350->900%, viscosity 12000->3000 cP, tear 22->38 pli) — memory is unreliable for datasheet numbers; always cite the TDS.

datasheet.source: Smooth-On Dragon Skin 10 Medium TDS (smooth-on.com/products/dragon-skin-10-medium, accessed 2026-07-31)

soft-clay-10a.use_case: firmer gummy elastomer — structural deformable parts that must hold shape (variant = Dragon Skin 10 Medium)
soft-clay-10a.datasheet_values_status: VERIFIED against Smooth-On Dragon Skin 10 Medium TDS 2026-07-31. NOTE: earlier nominal elongation 425% was WRONG — actual 1000%.

hyperelastic_model.framework: Ogden (N=3), incompressible, true (Cauchy) stress, uniaxial tension

coefficients.status: fitted (re-fit from raw ASTM D412 data; see fitted-ogden.json)

notes: Ecoflex/Dragon Skin silicones are typically fit with a 2- or 3-term Ogden or a Yeoh model.
Fitted coefficients vary by study and by batch — always pull from the database and record the source + test standard (ASTM D412).

deformation_guidance.note: Visual profile is identical across variants; only compliance differs.

failure_modes.mitigation: bulk cast silicone (this profile) avoids the sticky-degradation failure mode of painted soft-touch coatings
